name: ICMR ethical guidelines for AI in biomedical research and healthcare (draft)
description: The principles of the Indian Council of Medical Research's 2023 ethical guidelines for AI in biomedical research and healthcare that Shio can evidence from its artefacts.
limits: The guidelines are ethical principles, not a checklist: this pack maps the ones Shio's artefacts can evidence and leaves the rest (ethics committee review, collaboration, accessibility) to people. Principle names follow the 2023 guidelines as published; counsel and the clinical safety lead must check the mapping.

frameworks.title: ICMR Ethical Guidelines for Application of Artificial Intelligence in Biomedical Research and Healthcare (2023)

controls.title: Autonomy: a person stays in control
controls.requirement: Clinical outcomes need a clinician's sign-off; the model only reads.

controls.title: Safety and risk minimisation
controls.requirement: Hazards and their controls are kept in a safety case approved by the clinical safety lead.

controls.title: Trustworthiness: outputs tied to their source
controls.requirement: Every claim in a clinical output carries its quote from the source.

controls.title: Data privacy
controls.requirement: Identifiers are removed from outputs and kept out of records except the erasable vault.

controls.title: Accountability
controls.requirement: Every decision is a signed record naming the program, models and people involved.

controls.title: Validity
controls.requirement: Performance is measured in CI against labelled cases.

controls.title: Non-discrimination and fairness
controls.requirement: Performance is compared across subgroups and the gap bounded.
